about: Known differences against the tag database (src/data/ades.txt), found 2026-11-25 by tests/lanes/qa/tag-db.cjs. Each one has its reason; the lane that owns the row fixes it and removes it here. A new difference is never added here without a reason. A row whose tag is the drawing's spelling carries io = the I/O list name (field MIR-L-1090 / ARP / IRP, alarm PSL-DO1043-x1 where the alarm list 20160912 writes PSL for the PSH-DO1043 HIGH switch); the test checks io.
